method: Cohen's kappa between the panel's labels and a second blind rater's on a seeded random 10 % of the snapshot's distinct lines. Population: match.ts novelLines(snapshot) as {repo, tag, line} (text), grouped by repo in novelLines' order and cut into slices of at most 450 lines; the slices sorted by line count, largest first (Python's stable sort, so equal counts keep that order), and concatenated. Sample: Python random.Random(20261014).sample(population, 996). sampleSha256 is the SHA-256 of the sample's 'repo<TAB>line' keys, sorted and joined by newlines, so a re-draw can be checked.
note: Below the pre-registration's 0.6 flag. With 3 to 4 true lines in 996, kappa is unstable: one line more or less in either column moves it by about 0.2. The owner decides whether the rating can be trusted (docs/prereg/watcher.md, Independent rating). The verdict does not rest on the rating's precision: even if every one of the 110 flagged lines in the batch that rated no line true (batch 8, which holds llm-d v0.10.0's fs-connector deprecation) were true, precision would be 24.1 %, still under the 25 % bar. Do not reuse ratings.json as a gold set.

secondRaterTrue.line: **KVBM (KV Block Manager) is deprecated in v1.5.0 and removal is targeted for v1.6.0; the `kvbm` wheel and the vLLM KVBM launch and deploy examples ship unchanged for this release**.

**Rust EPP Frontend Image:** Shipped the Rust Endpoint Picker binary inside the Dynamo Frontend image at `/epp`, replacing the Go EPP. A standalone `dynamo-epp` image is planned for a later release (\#11355).

**Initial support for the Rust frontend**: Migrates the front half of the server, everything from network ingress up to the point a tokenized request is handed to the GPU scheduler, from Python to a multi-threaded Rust implementation ([#29799](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/29799)).
